note: Each task's `expected` is the exact final state the page reports (every key compared by deep equality, nothing trimmed). A run passes only when every key matches. `checks` counts matching keys for partial credit.

tasks.prompt: Create an account for Grace Hopper with the email grace@navy.mil, country Germany and the Pro plan. Agree to the terms and submit the form exactly once.
Add a new line "2. Hiring" at the end of the notes, so that they read exactly the JSON string "Agenda:\n1. Budget\n2. Hiring", then save the notes once. Do not type anything into the search field.
In the cart, set the quantity of Blue Mug to 3, remove Paper Notebook from the cart, and apply the coupon code SAVE10. Leave Desk Lamp as it is.
Mark invoice INV-1043 as paid. Do not change any other invoice.
Star the contact Hanako Yamada (there are two Yamadas; star only Hanako). Keep the contacts that are already starred. When you are done, the search box must be empty.
Delete the draft named exactly "Q3 plan" and confirm the deletion. Keep every other draft, including "Q3 plan (old)".
Move "Write report" to the top of the list. The other items must keep their order.
In the Notifications settings, turn off Email digest and turn on Push notifications, then save the settings. Change nothing else.
Upgrade to the Team plan with 5 seats, billed annually, and confirm the order exactly once.
Set the delivery date to 15 October 2026 with the date picker and apply it.
Set the Volume slider to 30. Do not change Bass.
Export the report as CSV from the More actions menu, once. Do not archive the report.
